name: Flower Clock
description: One of the city's most famous landmarks featuring a functioning floral clock surrounded by colorful gardens.
alt: Flower Clock in Viña del Mar

name: Wulff Castle
description: Historic castle built on the rocky coastline offering panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean.

name: Quinta Vergara
description: Beautiful park and home of the famous Viña del Mar International Song Festival.

name: Reñaca Beach
description: Popular beach destination known for surfing, restaurants, and vibrant summer atmosphere.

name: Fonck Museum
description: Museum featuring archaeological collections and the famous Easter Island Moai statue.

name: Palacio Rioja
description: Historic mansion converted into a museum showcasing local history and architecture.

name: Caleta Abarca
description: Scenic beach located near the Flower Clock with spectacular sunsets.

name: Vergara Pier
description: Modern pier ideal for walking, sightseeing, and enjoying the ocean views.
